visualDirection: serious-cute mature pixel art; warm bronze skin; long dark curls; teal, bronze and earthy-gold bloom-mage styling
motionRules: Movement flows through curls, sleeves, skirt panels and jewelry with overlap and follow-through.
Petals lag behind the body and bloom outward over several frames instead of appearing as a static aura.
Keep Kaelani graceful and grounded rather than bouncy or childlike.
Landing uses a soft compression and hair/skirt settle frame before returning to idle.
